name: Masling
comments: I maintain Crossword Clue Tutor and would like to suggest a free classroom resource that complements crossword puzzle builders by teaching students how to solve and explain clues. The Grades 6–12 guide at https://crosswordcluetutor.com/guides/crossword-clues-for-vocabulary-learning/ uses grammar, answer length, trusted crossings, and progressive hints for vocabulary inference. It includes a printable worksheet and teacher key at https://crosswordcluetutor.com/educators/crossword-vocabulary-worksheet/ plus an account-free classroom solver at https://crosswordcluetutor.com/classroom-solver/. The classroom pages omit Google Analytics, and the materials do not reproduce a commercial puzzle or answer key. Full disclosure: I maintain the suggested site.
